props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, tied to the control.

props.name: value
props.description: The canonical value; `null` means empty. Bindable through `onValueChange`.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for parsing and display. Defaults to the provider's locale.

props.name: step
props.description: Step for the spin actions; typed values are validated against it.

props.name: changeOnWheel
props.description: Opt in to wheel stepping while the input is focused and hovered.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional hint shown under the control and linked via aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; when non-empty the field becomes invalid and announces it.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the canonical ASCII value is submitted under it.

props.name: form
props.description: Id of the owning form when the field renders outside of it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the canonical value changes while editing.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called at commit boundaries: blur, Enter, and spin actions.
